scope_exclusions.title: Focus Appearance
scope_exclusions.reason: Level AAA; excluded from this A/AA inventory.

scope_exclusions.title: Parsing
scope_exclusions.reason: WCAG 2.2 obsolete criterion; not applicable to this inventory.

criteria.title: Non-text Content
criteria.intent: Provide text alternatives for non-text content, except where an exception applies.

criteria.title: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.intent: Provide an equivalent alternative for prerecorded audio-only and video-only content.

criteria.title: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.intent: Provide captions for prerecorded synchronized audio and video content.

criteria.title: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.intent: Provide audio description or a complete text alternative for prerecorded synchronized media.

criteria.title: Captions (Live)
criteria.intent: Provide captions for live synchronized audio and video content.

criteria.title: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.intent: Provide audio description for prerecorded video content.

criteria.title: Info and Relationships
criteria.intent: Make information, structure, and relationships programmatically determinable or available in text.

criteria.title: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.intent: Preserve a meaningful reading or interaction sequence when presentation order matters.

criteria.title: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.intent: Do not rely solely on sensory characteristics to identify instructions or content.

criteria.title: Orientation
criteria.intent: Support content and functionality in both portrait and landscape orientation unless an exception applies.

criteria.title: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.intent: Programmatically identify the purpose of specified user-input fields.

criteria.title: Use of Color
criteria.intent: Do not use color as the only visual means of conveying information, action, or distinction.

criteria.title: Audio Control
criteria.intent: Provide a mechanism to pause or stop certain automatically playing audio or control its volume.

criteria.title: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.intent: Meet minimum text and image-of-text contrast ratios, subject to defined exceptions.

criteria.title: Resize Text
criteria.intent: Allow text to be resized up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality.

criteria.title: Images of Text
criteria.intent: Use text rather than images of text except where an exception applies.

criteria.title: Reflow
criteria.intent: Present content without two-dimensional scrolling at specified narrow viewport or zoom conditions, except where essential.

criteria.title: Non-text Contrast
criteria.intent: Provide required contrast for visual information needed to identify interface components and graphical objects.

criteria.title: Text Spacing
criteria.intent: Preserve content and functionality when users override specified text-spacing properties.

criteria.title: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.intent: Make additional content shown on hover or focus dismissible, hoverable, and persistent as required.

criteria.title: Keyboard
criteria.intent: Make all functionality operable through a keyboard interface, except where the function depends on path-based input.

criteria.title: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.intent: Allow keyboard focus to move away from every component using only the keyboard.

criteria.title: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.intent: Provide a way to turn off, remap, or limit single-character shortcuts in applicable contexts.

criteria.title: Timing Adjustable
criteria.intent: Allow users to turn off, adjust, or extend time limits, subject to exceptions.

criteria.title: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.intent: Provide controls for certain moving, blinking, scrolling, or auto-updating content.

criteria.title: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.intent: Ensure content does not flash more than three times per second unless below defined thresholds.

criteria.title: Bypass Blocks
criteria.intent: Provide a way to bypass blocks of content repeated across multiple pages.

criteria.title: Page Titled
criteria.intent: Give each web page a title that describes its topic or purpose.

criteria.title: Focus Order
criteria.intent: Ensure sequential focus order preserves meaning and operability.

criteria.title: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.intent: Make the purpose of each link determinable from its text or programmatically determined context, with exceptions.

criteria.title: Multiple Ways
criteria.intent: Provide more than one way to locate a page within a set of pages, subject to exceptions.

criteria.title: Headings and Labels
criteria.intent: Use headings and labels that describe topic or purpose.

criteria.title: Focus Visible
criteria.intent: Make the keyboard focus indicator visible.

criteria.title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.intent: Ensure a focused component is not entirely hidden by author-created content.

criteria.title: Pointer Gestures
criteria.intent: Provide a single-pointer alternative for multipoint or path-based gestures, except where essential.

criteria.title: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.intent: Support at least one specified safeguard against accidental pointer activation.

criteria.title: Label in Name
criteria.intent: Include visible text labels in the accessible names of applicable controls.

criteria.title: Motion Actuation
criteria.intent: Provide an alternative to functionality triggered by device motion or user gestures, with exceptions.

criteria.title: Dragging Movements
criteria.intent: Provide a single-pointer alternative for functionality that uses dragging, unless dragging is essential.

criteria.title: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.intent: Ensure pointer targets meet minimum size or spacing requirements, subject to exceptions.

criteria.title: Language of Page
criteria.intent: Programmatically determine the default human language of each page.

criteria.title: Language of Parts
criteria.intent: Programmatically identify changes in the language of passages or phrases, with exceptions.

criteria.title: On Focus
criteria.intent: Avoid a change of context solely because a component receives focus.

criteria.title: On Input
criteria.intent: Avoid unexpected changes of context when changing a user-interface control setting, unless users were advised.

criteria.title: Consistent Navigation
criteria.intent: Keep repeated navigation mechanisms in a consistent relative order across pages.

criteria.title: Consistent Identification
criteria.intent: Identify components with the same functionality consistently across pages.

criteria.title: Consistent Help
criteria.intent: Keep specified help mechanisms in a consistent relative order across pages.

criteria.title: Error Identification
criteria.intent: Identify input errors and describe them to users in text.

criteria.title: Labels or Instructions
criteria.intent: Provide labels or instructions when content requires user input.

criteria.title: Error Suggestion
criteria.intent: Provide correction suggestions when known and appropriate for input errors.

criteria.title: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.intent: Provide specified safeguards for submissions involving legal commitments, financial transactions, or user-controlled data.

criteria.title: Redundant Entry
criteria.intent: Avoid requiring users to re-enter information already supplied in the same process, subject to exceptions.

criteria.title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.intent: Avoid requiring a cognitive function test for authentication unless an exception or alternative applies.

criteria.title: Name, Role, Value
criteria.intent: Ensure name, role, and state information for user-interface components is programmatically determinable and changeable.

criteria.title: Status Messages
criteria.intent: Make status messages programmatically determinable without requiring focus, using appropriate roles or properties.
